refnamediv.refpurpose: Reduces the number of colors in a sequence of images

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
numberColors
The maximum number of colors in the resulting images. If 0, or a value greater than the maximum colormap size supported by ImageMagick, is given, the maximum colormap size is used.
colorspace
The colorspace in which the color reduction is performed, one of the COLORSPACE constants, typically Imagick::COLORSPACE_RGB.
treedepth
The depth of the color classification tree. If 0, an optimal depth is computed from numberColors, which generally gives the best representation of the images with the least amount of memory and the fastest computational speed. Other values are clamped between 2 and 8. A different depth may be required for images with a low color dispersion (only a few colors), and a value of 8 expands the color tree completely.
dither
Whether to distribute the color error between neighboring pixels (dithering), which reduces color banding at the cost of some noise.
When Imagick is compiled against ImageMagick 7, this value is passed to ImageMagick as a dither method rather than as a boolean, which inverts its meaning: &true; disables dithering, while &false; enables Floyd-Steinberg dithering.
measureError
Whether to measure the difference between the original and the quantized images (the total quantization error). This does not change the resulting images.
